contexts.statement: OpenAI Math Audit #053: A counterexample to Pixton completeness in Chow.

Audit the fixed all-output Chow recursion and its selected bare marked moments under independent Euler and moving shifts, uniformly at every finite length and output cutoff. Verification of this interface does not verify the full Pixton counterexample.

definitions.M_k(alpha): formal integral of z^k alpha over one connected surface component
definitions.E_m: genuine unmarked moments, M_m(1)=1, and all other marked moments zero
definitions.x_e: base-line Euler shift of the high fixed tautological bundle
definitions.x_m: independent shift of the moving Euler ratio

contexts.statement: Audit the determinant-fixed surface Quot localization relation for a smooth projective curve family C/S with section, b>=5, smooth irreducible quasi-projective complex base S, and dim S<(b-1)^2-1; retain the reviewed marked representative and treat the Section 04 tensor realization as an unverified input.

The manuscript explicit class Y has zero rational Chow realization and lies outside the original Pixton relation span.
The formal Frobenius detector annihilates the original Pixton span and detects Y.
The corrected compactified candidate Y has zero rational Chow realization.
The corrected-cubic comparison and support induction transfer the smooth-family identity to the compactification.
The isotropic surface bound implies sufficiently long arbitrary-color product vanishing as stated in the manuscript.
Under the manuscript surface-theorem hypotheses, T_gamma^(25(b-1)^2-1)=0 in the stated support quotient.
The determinant-fixed Quot localization and codimension exclusions give a_(N,t) T_gamma^t=0 for the fixed marked representative.
The consecutive nested-Hilbert procedure produces a functorial finite polynomial in decorated output diagonals and closed components without integrating outputs.

For every finite length and output cutoff, the fixed all-output recursion permits the bare-triple moment specialization and independent Euler and moving shifts and yields the manuscript first hyperplane coefficient and scalar-final-series.

At every finite moment cutoff, a genuine unmarked vector plus any single selected bare marked moment is in the rational span of genuine moment vectors; additive polynomial logarithms restrict linearly to that span.
The fixed marked recursion commutes with H -> H-x_e before degree truncation, and shifted additivity removes every nonlinear moment-count component at the bare evaluation.
Restriction to transverse curves gives the manuscript two-symmetric-power logarithm, with its cross Hom factors and incidence signs.
The bare-triple logarithmic coefficient satisfies c(q,0,x_m)=0 and [x]c(q,x,x)=q(1+2q)/(1+4q)^(3/2).
For the manuscript parameters, the residue expression for the already transferred scalar is nonzero.

claims.natural_statement: The localization virtual-rank gap, integral low-divisor support bound, four ordered branch lengths, short-length inequality, and unique equality case of the output block budget hold uniformly for b>=5.
claims.formal_statement:
import Mathlib

namespace LocalizationAudit

def chi (q : ℤ) : ℤ := q ^ 2
def surfaceSquare (q : ℤ) : ℤ := 8 * chi q
def t (q : ℤ) : ℤ := 25 * chi q - 1
def nu (q : ℤ) : ℤ := t q - 1
def lengthN (q : ℤ) : ℤ := nu q + 3 * surfaceSquare q
def virtualRank (q : ℤ) : ℤ := 2 * t q + chi q - 3

theorem chi_lower_bound (q : ℤ) (hq : 4 ≤ q) : 16 ≤ chi q := by
  dsimp [chi]
  nlinarith

theorem rank_gap (q : ℤ) (hq : 4 ≤ q) : 2 * t q < virtualRank q := by
  have hc := chi_lower_bound q hq
  dsimp [virtualRank]
  omega

theorem numerical_parameters (q : ℤ) :
    lengthN q = 49 * chi q - 2 ∧
    virtualRank q = 51 * chi q - 5 ∧
    chi q + 3 * surfaceSquare q - 1 = t q := by
  dsimp [lengthN, nu, virtualRank, t, surfaceSquare]
  constructor
  · ring
  constructor <;> ring

theorem branch_thresholds (q : ℤ) (hq : 4 ≤ q) :
    t q ≤ lengthN q ∧ nu q < t q ∧ nu q - surfaceSquare q < t q := by
  have hc := chi_lower_bound q hq
  dsimp [lengthN, nu, surfaceSquare]
  omega

theorem high_index_exists (a b s : ℚ) (hs : 0 < s) (h : a + b = 3 * s) :
    s < a ∨ s < b := by
  by_contra! hn
  linarith

theorem support_factorization (q p : ℚ) :
    (p - 2 * q) * (8 * q ^ 2 - 2 * q - p) =
      8 * q ^ 2 * p - p ^ 2 - 16 * q ^ 3 + 4 * q ^ 2 := by
  ring

theorem integral_support_bound (q n : ℤ) (p : ℚ)
    (hq : 1 ≤ q)
    (hp0 : 2 * (q : ℚ) ≤ p)
    (hp1 : p ≤ 8 * (q : ℚ) ^ 2 - 2 * (q : ℚ))
    (hH : 8 * (q : ℚ) ^ 2 * (2 * (n : ℚ) + p) ≤ p ^ 2) :
    n ≤ -q := by
  have hqQ : (1 : ℚ) ≤ (q : ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast hq
  have hqpos : (0 : ℚ) < (q : ℚ) := by linarith
  have hq2 : (0 : ℚ) < (q : ℚ) ^ 2 := by positivity
  have hprod :
      0 ≤ (p - 2 * (q : ℚ)) *
        (8 * (q : ℚ) ^ 2 - 2 * (q : ℚ) - p) :=
    mul_nonneg (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have hscaled :
      16 * (q : ℚ) ^ 2 * ((n : ℚ) + (q : ℚ)) ≤
        4 * (q : ℚ) ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith [hprod]
  by_contra hn
  have hnI : 1 ≤ n + q := by omega
  have hnQ : (1 : ℚ) ≤ (n : ℚ) + (q : ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast hnI
  have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hnQ
    (show (0 : ℚ) ≤ 16 * (q : ℚ) ^ 2 by positivity)
  nlinarith

theorem short_length_exclusion (t n k : ℤ) (hn : n < t) :
    4 * t - 2 * k < 2 * (3 * t - k - n) := by
  omega

def blockCost (k : ℕ) : ℤ :=
  if k = 1 then 2 else if k = 2 then 4 else 2 * ((k : ℤ) - 1)

theorem block_budget (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) :
    4 * (k : ℤ) ≤ 3 * blockCost k ∧
    (4 * (k : ℤ) = 3 * blockCost k ↔ k = 3) := by
  unfold blockCost
  split_ifs with h1 h2
  · subst k
    norm_num
  · subst k
    norm_num
  · have hk3 : 3 ≤ k := by omega
    constructor
    · omega
    · constructor <;> intro h <;> omega

def slack (k : ℕ) : ℤ := 3 * blockCost k - 4 * (k : ℤ)

theorem slack_sum_nonneg (ks : List ℕ)
    (hp : ∀ k ∈ ks, 1 ≤ k) : 0 ≤ (ks.map slack).sum := by
  induction ks with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a ks ih =>
    have ha := (block_budget a (hp a (by simp))).1
    have ht := ih (fun k hk => hp k (by simp [hk]))
    simp only [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons]
    dsimp [slack]
    linarith

theorem zero_slack_only_triples (ks : List ℕ)
    (hp : ∀ k ∈ ks, 1 ≤ k) (hz : (ks.map slack).sum = 0) :
    ∀ k ∈ ks, k = 3 := by
  induction ks with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a ks ih =>
    have hpa : 1 ≤ a := hp a (by simp)
    have hpt : ∀ k ∈ ks, 1 ≤ k := fun k hk => hp k (by simp [hk])
    have hsa : 0 ≤ slack a := by
      dsimp [slack]
      linarith [(block_budget a hpa).1]
    have hst := slack_sum_nonneg ks hpt
    simp only [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons] at hz
    have hza : slack a = 0 := by linarith
    have hzt : (ks.map slack).sum = 0 := by linarith
    have ha : a = 3 := (block_budget a hpa).2.mp (by
      dsimp [slack] at hza
      linarith)
    intro k hk
    simp only [List.mem_cons] at hk
    rcases hk with hka | hkt
    · simpa [hka] using ha
    · exact ih hpt hzt k hkt

theorem based_trace_cancellation (a : ℚ) : -a - (1 - a) = -1 := by
  ring

theorem riemann_roch_rank (nu l1d l2d kd dsq chi : ℚ) :
    (2 * (nu + l1d - dsq / 2) - (kd + l1d + l2d) + dsq) + chi - 1 =
      2 * nu + (l1d - l2d - kd) + chi - 1 := by
  ring

end LocalizationAudit

def blockCost (k : ℕ) : ℤ :=

theorem block_budget (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) :

    (4 * (k : ℤ) = 3 * blockCost k ↔ k = 3) := by

  split_ifs with h1 h2
  · subst k
    norm_num
  · subst k
    norm_num
  · have hk3 : 3 ≤ k := by omega
    constructor
    · omega

def slack (k : ℕ) : ℤ := 3 * blockCost k - 4 * (k : ℤ)

theorem slack_sum_nonneg (ks : List ℕ)

      dsimp [slack] at hza
      linarith)
